purpose: Translate top-conference evidence gaps into concrete, auditable experiments.
current_position: Workflow-design contribution with reproducible pilot evidence; not yet proof of superiority over autonomous AI Scientist-v2.

milestones.claim_tested: Review-derived and IGRE-gated feedback improves research artifacts under qualified human review.
milestones.minimum_design: 3-5 qualified reviewers with ML/AI expertise, preferably NUS-affiliated or school-affiliated faculty, postdocs, PhD students, or advanced research students, score the same six anonymized pairs when feasible.
milestones.ethics_and_recruitment_boundary: Recruitment should proceed only after institutional ethics review, departmental review, or exemption determination. Generic Prolific or crowd-worker evaluation is supplementary unless ML/AI expertise is verified.
milestones.upgrade_condition: Gate-routed or review-guided artifacts win a majority of non-tied comparisons with positive novelty or rigor deltas.
milestones.fallback_if_failed: Keep the claim at offline review signals are routeable; remove paper-quality improvement claims.

milestones.claim_tested: Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 improves the outcome distribution relative to autonomous AI Scientist-v2 under the same budget.
milestones.minimum_design: At least 3 tasks and 5 matched pairs per task with same model family, tool access, step budget, task, and stopping rules.
milestones.upgrade_condition: Human-gated runs improve high-quality manuscript rate or evaluator-robustness rate without a large average task-score regression.
milestones.fallback_if_failed: Frame IGRE as safety and workflow control rather than performance improvement.

milestones.claim_tested: Some short-term-unhelpful human review comments can guide past research toward later frontier developments.
milestones.minimum_design: Replay at least 30 delayed-value candidates and 30 matched controls after match-drift guards.
milestones.upgrade_condition: At least one clear positive delayed-value case plus aggregate advantage over controls under semantic or expert judging.
milestones.delayed_value_success_case: A replay can be positive even if immediate paper-quality or original-task score decreases, provided the review-guided trajectory is more aligned with later mainstream or SOTA field developments than both paper-only and shuffled-review controls.
milestones.fallback_if_failed: Keep LHTG/DVRS as a falsifiable measurement protocol and report negative evidence.

milestones.claim_tested: Broad OpenReview screening can identify concrete historical paper-review pairs where human review guidance changes the automatic-research trajectory in an interpretable way.
milestones.minimum_design: At least three selected cases from deep_regeneration_casebook.md, each with original paper summary, human review excerpts, regenerated artifacts, runnable experiment code or logs, short-term metrics, later-frontier evidence, and case-level route analysis.
milestones.upgrade_condition: The cases reveal inspectable mechanisms by which review guidance changes benchmarks, methods, failure analysis, or claim boundaries, with at least one case showing nontrivial similarity to a later mainstream research route.
milestones.fallback_if_failed: Keep the paper as a workflow/protocol proposal and use the failures to define which human review comments should be downweighted.

milestones.claim_tested: The gate schema captures real human taste and attention cost beyond a single-author trace.
milestones.minimum_design: At least 20 prospective gates from at least 5 researchers with complete attention_cost and taste_insight fields.
milestones.upgrade_condition: Human interventions include non-metric reasons and can be linked to downstream search-control changes.
milestones.fallback_if_failed: Describe the schema as single-author prototype tooling.

milestones.claim_tested: The workflow is not overfit to FML-Bench-style evidence and can be evaluated on official non-FML MLAgentBench tasks.
milestones.minimum_design: At least one scored official non-FML MLAgentBench task plus a plan to scale across more seeds or another official task.
milestones.upgrade_condition: The official non-FML benchmark shows workflow benefit or evaluator-safety benefit and is not treated as broad coverage without scale.
milestones.fallback_if_failed: Limit official non-FML claims to the scored CIFAR10/debug task and keep broader benchmark claims future-facing.

milestones.claim_tested: IGRE can be packaged as a reusable research skill that other researchers can install, run, and adapt without confusing engineering adoption with scientific superiority.
milestones.minimum_design: Publish a standalone skill README, install instructions, quickstart, templates, validation script, example gate trajectory, isolated install smoke test, global install smoke, clean external temporary reuse smoke, and at least one external researcher or independently prepared environment that produces a valid gate log.
milestones.current_progress: The package has a release scaffold, isolated install smoke, global install audit, global reuse smoke, metric-gaming evaluator smoke, and clean external temporary reuse smoke. These support engineering transfer, not external community adoption or scientific performance.
milestones.metrics: Install success, quickstart completion, valid gate-log generation, external issue or PR activity, example reuse count, and eventually stars or forks.
milestones.upgrade_condition: At least one external researcher or independently prepared external environment successfully runs the skill on a new topic and produces a valid gate log; broader community claims require observed external reuse such as issues, PRs, forks, or stars.
milestones.fallback_if_failed: Keep the skill as an internal artifact and do not claim engineering transferability or community adoption.

submission_decision_rule.pilot_or_system_paper: Submit only after blind human expert review or matched autonomous-vs-human runs produce positive evidence.
submission_decision_rule.top_conference_empirical_paper: Submit only after blind human expert review and matched autonomous-vs-human runs both pass, with LHTG/DVRS replay providing either positive delayed-value evidence or a strong negative measurement result.

claim_boundary: IGRE, LHTG, TFR, and DVRS define an auditable human-participation workflow for automated science; the current package demonstrates reproducible operationalization and pilot signals, but not empirical superiority over autonomous AI Scientist-v2.

priority_queue.proof_target: Move from one scored official MLAgentBench task to a more robust non-FML evidence slice.
priority_queue.current_progress: MLAgentBench vectorization is scored, the open-data sklearn matched package provides official-like held-out trigger-policy evidence, and MLAgentBench CIFAR10/debug is now a scored official task after pre-caching the official CIFAR10 archive: 0.5103 starter baseline versus 0.7782 co-pilot-selected branch, delta +0.2679.
priority_queue.best_near_term_path: Rerun CIFAR10/debug across additional seeds or repair one more accessible MLAgentBench task with complete gate logs.
priority_queue.blocking_condition: Data access, CPU/GPU runtime, or external account consent prevents additional official scores.
priority_queue.fallback_if_blocked: Report the current official CIFAR result as one-task evidence only.

priority_queue.proof_target: Test whether qualified human reviewers prefer IGRE-gated or review-guided artifacts under anonymized scoring.
priority_queue.best_near_term_path: Recruit NUS or school-affiliated ML/AI reviewers after ethics or departmental exemption review.
priority_queue.blocking_condition: No qualified reviewers are available or ethics/exemption review is not cleared.
priority_queue.fallback_if_blocked: Use model-only dry runs only to debug the packet, not as human evidence.

priority_queue.action: Matched multi-task autonomous versus human-gated runs
priority_queue.proof_target: Test whether co-pilot gates improve valid-run rate, evaluator robustness, or manuscript quality without unacceptable task-score regression.
priority_queue.best_near_term_path: Extend the current prospective package format to at least three task families and five matched pairs per task.
priority_queue.blocking_condition: API budget, compute budget, or remote benchmark setup prevents enough paired runs.
priority_queue.fallback_if_blocked: Keep current pilot evidence and report power limitations instead of upgrading superiority claims.

priority_queue.action: Deep TFR replay cases from the candidate queue
priority_queue.proof_target: Find at least one inspectable delayed-value or frontier-route case, or produce a stronger negative result about historical peer-review guidance.
priority_queue.best_near_term_path: Choose cases from the delayed-value candidate queue using the OpenAlex validation score, then generate paper-only, review-guided, shuffled-control, and six-gate artifacts.
priority_queue.blocking_condition: Citation-frontier reconstruction is too thin or match-drift risk is too high.
priority_queue.fallback_if_blocked: Report the candidate as unscored or drift-risk rather than treating review text as a taste oracle.

priority_queue.action: External skill reuse beyond scripted clean environments
priority_queue.proof_target: Show that the release skill can be used by another researcher or independently prepared environment to produce a valid gate log.
priority_queue.best_near_term_path: Invite one external tester after the release package is stable.
priority_queue.fallback_if_blocked: Do not substitute repository stars or scripted local reuse for independent adoption evidence.

next_experiment_selection_rule: Choose the highest-priority item whose blocking condition is not active; if it is blocked, archive the blocker and move to the next item without upgrading claims.
